analytics-legacy: Ebipimo tebiriwo ku lipoota eno. Ddamu oteekeko demo okukola okwekenneenya okw'omu kiseera kino.
analytics-partial: Ebipimo ebimu birina ebikwata ku muzannyo ebitono okuva ku nsibuko
comparison-note: Geraageranya abazannyi ku kipimo kye kimu. Ebipimo ebibulamu tebibalibwa.
diagnostics-note: Obubaka obwasooka obw'okukebera okuva mu mpeereza y'okwekenneenya.
grenade-note: Obuvune obwawandiikibwa obwatuusibwa ku mulabe ne bbomu za HE n'omuliro. Ebipimo ebibulamu ku nsibuko bisigala nga tebiriwo.
impact-note: Omugaso mu buli lawundi okusinziira ku mbeera. Empeereza y'okwekenneenya y'esalawo engeri y'okupimamu.
metric-definitions: ADR: obuvune obwa wakati mu lawundi. KAST: lawundi ezirimu okutta, okuyamba, okusigala nga mulamu oba okutta eyasse munno. K/D ey'okutandika: okutta okusooka mu lawundi. TK: okutta munno mu timu. Omulimu, Omugaso n'Ensobi byetaaga okubala okusinziira ku mbeera mu mpeereza y'okwekenneenya.
no-confirmed-harm: Tewali kikolwa kya bulabe kikakasiddwa; okulonda kwesigamiziddwa ku bbula ery’okugeraageranya ery’omugabo omulungi.
no-teams: Tewali lukalala lwa bazannyi ba timu olukakasiddwa.
partial-warning: Ebimu ku bikwata ku muzannyo tebyakakasiddwa. Ebipimo tebiriwo; soma ebigambo ku mutindo wansi.
quality-notes: Ebigambo ku mutindo gw'ebikwata ku muzannyo
rating-note: Erinnya lirabika wano nga waliwo ekipimo ekisinziira ku mbeera yokka.
relative-index-note: Omuwendo ogw’okugeraageranya si kigero kya mukisa era si bukakafu bwa kigendererwa.
round-hint: Londa lawundi okukebera obubonero bwayo ne tik za demo.
scoreboard-source: K/D/A eva mu lukalala lw'obubonero olusomeddwa. Akasaze kalaga nti ekipimo tekiriwo. Obubonero bw'enjuyi bukwata ku lawundi eyasembayo okuwandiikibwa.
